text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, which usually last two to four weeks. Each sprint focuses on completing a small part of the project. Teams hold daily standups, short meetings where members share progress and problems. The work is organized in a backlog, a list of tasks and user stories that describe what users need. Through iterative development, the team improves the product step by step, based on feedback. This flexible approach helps teams respond quickly to changes and deliver value faster.
